title: Zone perimeter boundary crossing versus authorization
question: Describe the person's movement across the perimeter boundary line. Does this footage establish unauthorized entry or trespassing?

grading.unsupported_claims: strictly fail if any unsupported claim ('unauthorized_entry', 'trespassing', 'perimeter_breach_violation') is asserted
grading.evidence: must cite at least one valid supplied timestamp between 10.0s and 15.0s
